title: Akamai scenario lab
purpose: Expose the revenue, cash-flow, and valuation conditions required for the market to be right or wrong about Akamai's cloud-infrastructure and agent-control opportunity. This is not a price target, a forecast, or analyst consensus.

notes: FY2026 revenue and non-GAAP operating-margin guidance are company-issued midpoints / ranges as of the Q2 2026 release.
The H1 capital-investment proxy is purchases of property and equipment plus capitalization of internal-use software. It is not a company-defined free-cash-flow measure.

The net-debt bridge uses June 30 cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities less convertible senior notes. It does not project future cash, debt, dilution, hedges, buybacks, or convertibility effects.

The September 24 Anthropic agreement and its subsequent management timing plan are not mechanically incorporated in these scenarios. The 150M diluted-share bridge excludes the agreement's warrant and any contract-specific financing or capital-structure effects; it is not a pro forma share count.
The current share price is read only from the attributed current market snapshot at render time; no vendor price is stored in this scenario file.

scenarios.title: A — No meaningful Wave 2
scenarios.thesis: CIS grows but does not create a durable incremental profit pool; delivery pressure and capacity costs dominate.
scenarios.proof: CIS commitments fail to convert at attractive returns; delivery pricing or cloud-capacity costs outweigh growth.

scenarios.title: B — Material Wave 2
scenarios.thesis: CIS, security, and control-plane products grow faster than the legacy delivery drag, while capacity spending becomes more productive.
scenarios.proof: CIS commitment conversion, agent-control attach or pricing, and free-cash-flow recovery become visible in reported results.

scenarios.title: C — Strong agentic expansion
scenarios.thesis: Akamai becomes a scaled, differentiated edge-inference and control-plane beneficiary; returns on capacity investment and pricing power improve materially.
scenarios.proof: Agentic workloads become disclosed, paid, high-retention demand and capacity investment earns an improving cash return.

reverseExpectation.note: For each selected FY2030 FCF multiple, the lab derives the FCF required to support the current market enterprise value, then expresses it as a margin on a deliberately simple $6.0B revenue reference. This is a reverse-expectations sensitivity, not a DCF.
